participation.scopeWeight: Shares use cumulative responsibility time, so longer work items carry more weight. Periods without samples are left blank and do not mean zero duration.

members.method: Tasks belong to their current human owner; Agent tasks belong to the assigning operator. Unassigned tasks and historical members are listed separately. Tasks are deduplicated by work item ID. The scope covers tasks created or having events or execution activity in the selected period. Completed follows the dashboard definition of successful delivery during the period; in progress, not started and pending decision/review use the unified dashboard categories (IN_PROGRESS, NEW, PENDING_DECISION) and exclude tasks completed in the period, so the four columns are mutually exclusive. Total tasks excludes canceled tasks and may be larger than the sum of the four columns. Requirements delivered count only REQ. Times are in Beijing time.

model.anomalyRising: Anomaly intensity rose above the baseline over {{date}}, driven mainly by changes in retry and rejection shares.
model.anomalyFalling: Anomaly intensity fell below the baseline over {{date}}, driven mainly by changes in retry and rejection shares.

model.handoffNormal: Handoff event density is within the normal range.
model.impactHigh: May cause repeated idle rounds on the same work item
model.impactMedium: Extends turnaround time before a decision

model.recommendSync: {{worker}}: prioritize handoff synchronization and review evidence in SDLC records over {{date}} to avoid state changes without progress updates.
model.recommendWait: {{worker}}: after a review rejection, wait for a new review request before continuing to reduce repeated polling.
model.recommendAcceptance: {{worker}}: add a secondary acceptance field to frequently blocked workflows to distinguish running, awaiting decision and completed states.
model.recommendAudit: {{worker}}: increase audit sampling on anomaly days, focusing on whether retries, reopen events and state changes occur in pairs.

stages.title: Stage duration
stages.filtersFailure: Could not load filters. Please retry.
stages.empty: No stage records in this range. Adjust the dates or filters.
stages.scope: Samples are selected by execution creation date (Asia/Shanghai). Squad filtering uses current membership. Each execution counts separately; a workitem may have several executions.
stages.coverageDetail: {{missing}} observed stage samples have no start record. Executions without step events or an identifiable workflow are excluded from coverage.
stages.method: Totals include model, tool, validation and waiting time within a stage. Reruns add their actual intervals; gaps between stages are excluded. Average, P50 and P90 use completed stages with start records only. Running, incomplete, reused and skipped stages are counted separately; missing data is not zero.
stages.slowestNote: The 10 longest executions for each stage are shown. Missing durations display “—”. Open the workitem to inspect its execution records.
